mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.class_name, co.course_name, u.real_name as teacher_name, ts.slot_name, ts.day_of_week, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(ts.start_time, '%H:%i'),'-',DATE_FORMAT(ts.end_time, '%H:%i')) as time_range FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN course co ON s.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN user u ON s.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON s.time_slot_id = ts.id ORDER BY ts.day_of_week, ts.slot_name, c.class_name

SELECT s.*, c.class_name, co.course_name, u.real_name as teacher_name, ts.slot_name, ts.day_of_week, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(ts.start_time, '%H:%i'),'-',DATE_FORMAT(ts.end_time, '%H:%i')) as time_range FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN course co ON s.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN user u ON s.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON s.time_slot_id = ts.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
